abstract: PURPOSE: To determine the relative importance of computed tomographic (CT) measurements for the prediction of histologic findings in residual masses in patients with nonseminomatous testicular cancer. MATERIALS AND METHODS: Measurements of the maximum transverse size of retroperitoneal metastases before and after chemotherapy were available in 641 patients who underwent resection after chemotherapy while their levels of tumor markers were normal. Radiologic measurements of mass size and clinical characteristics (histologic findings in primary tumor and levels of alpha-fetoprotein, human chorionic gonadotropin, and lactate dehydrogenase before chemotherapy) were related to histologic findings in the residual mass with logistic regression analysis. RESULTS: At resection, 302 patients had benign tissue, and 339 had residual tumor (mature teratomas or cancer). Tumor was more frequent in larger masses after chemotherapy but was unrelated to mass size before chemotherapy. Inclusion of the reduction in size significantly improved the logistic regression model, which included mass size after chemotherapy. This model was further improved with the addition of clinical characteristics. Areas under the receiver operating characteristic curves increased from 0.74 to 0.77 and 0.83 with these models. CONCLUSION: A small retroperitoneal mass after chemotherapy is an important predictor of benign histologic findings in residual masses in patients with nonseminomatous testicular cancer. However, better predictions can be made when the reduction in size and clinical characteristics are considered as well. Decisions regarding resection should be based on the combination of these characteristics rather than on only mass size after chemotherapy.
abstract_ja:
目的：非セミノーマ性精巣がん患者の残存腫瘤について、CT計測が病理組織学的所見の予測に果たす相対的重要性を明らかにすること。
材料と方法：化学療法後に切除を受けた641例について、化学療法前後の後腹膜転移の最大横径の計測値が得られた。切除時の腫瘍マーカー値は正常範囲であった。化学療法前後の放射線学的計測値と臨床的特徴(原発巣の病理組織学的所見、化学療法前のαフェトプロテイン(AFP)、ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)、乳酸脱水素酵素(LDH)値)を、ロジスティック回帰分析で残存腫瘤の病理組織学的所見と関連付けた。
結果：切除時、302例は良性組織、339例は残存腫瘍(成熟奇形腫またはがん)であった。化学療法後により大きな腫瘤ほど腫瘍が多かったが、化学療法前の腫瘤径とは関連がなかった。縮小の程度を含めることでロジスティック回帰モデルは有意に改善し、化学療法後の腫瘤径を含むモデルがさらに改善された。臨床的特徴を追加するとモデルはさらに改善した。受信者動作特性曲線下面積は、0.74から0.77、さらに0.83へと増加した。
結論：化学療法後の小さな後腹膜腫瘤は、非セミノーマ性精巣がん患者の残存腫瘤が良性組織であることの重要な予測因子である。しかし、縮小の程度と臨床的特徴も考慮すると、より良い予測が可能である。切除の判断は、化学療法後の腫瘤径のみではなく、これらの特徴の組み合わせに基づくべきである。
